# Eligibility Criteria

This folder contains the specific inclusion rules and diagnostic codes required for patients to be registered in the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD). It details the exact ICD-10 action diagnoses from the National Patient Register—such as Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, short bowel syndrome, and primary sclerosing cholangitis—that define the eligible patient population for national clinical quality monitoring.

## Pages

- [[eligibility-criteria|Eligibility Criteria]] — Defines the specific ICD-10 action diagnoses and minimum hospital contact requirements for patient inclusion in the DANIBD registry.
